unit_audit.convention: Unconstrained unit choices assigned zero; not unique physical identification

representation.explanation: Exact symbolic equality of the supplied feature values forces any deterministic downstream function to give identical predictions. Unknown equalities are not merged. Passing this check does not prove the features sufficient or any model valid.

experiments.purpose: Prospective check that oldest-drive contribution changes with waiting time; compare to the newest-drive condition at the same u and h.
Matched temporal-position contrast with the preceding condition.
Check the oldest-drive contribution at longer waiting time.
Matched temporal-position contrast at longer waiting time.

annotation.prospective_contrast: The fit-only model will compare the oldest- and newest-drive coefficients and their interactions with h. The proposed four-condition follow-up repeats those matched temporal-position contrasts at two waiting times. It can refute a position-dependent, waiting-time-modulated history effect if the matched contrasts are equal within the calibrated 0.015 response error, or if the model misses the later independent targets beyond RMSE 0.06.
annotation.refutation_condition: Refute the endpoint-only representation if matched conditions sharing u, h, history[0], and history[3] but differing in history[1] or history[2] produce a response difference exceeding 0.030 (twice the certified absolute error bound). Refute the fitted model if independent raw-response RMSE exceeds 0.06.
annotation.scientific_change: Replace the insufficient assumption o=f(u,h) with a testable endpoint-history response: response may depend on the oldest and newest prior drives, with quadratic interactions allowing their effects to vary with current drive and waiting time. The observed ordered-history contrasts establish temporal-position sensitivity; intermediate history levels have not been shown negligible, so endpoint sufficiency remains a provisional, refutable restriction.
